Delta Manor is the central Ladner grid around Delta Secondary School and Memorial Park, in the City of Delta.
Delta Manor is not an official City neighbourhood name; it is the board sub-area name for that central grid.
Memorial Park is at 5010 47 Avenue, and Delta Secondary is at 4615 51 Street, both inside this pocket.
The governing plan is the Delta Official Community Plan (OCP) 2024, Bylaw No. 8400.
The stock is mainly single detached houses on the central Ladner grid, plus strata homes on 53 Street and 54a Street.
Secondary suites are listed as an accessory use to a single detached dwelling in the RS1 zone material read for this area.

blocks.text: Delta Manor: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Up to four units are allowed on single-detached and duplex lots under Delta's Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) updates.
Confirm the parcel's zone on the City zoning maps before assuming a suite or coach house fits.

blocks.text: Delta Manor: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Ladner Leisure Centre, at 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent, is the main Ladner recreation facility on the City pages.
School District 37 runs elementary schools Kindergarten to Grade 7 and secondary schools Grades 8 to 12, with no middle-school tier.
Ladner Village shops sit west of Chilukthan Slough, with commercial development on the east side of the slough, per the OCP village material.
Delta maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection and 31 drainage pump stations city-wide.

blocks.text: Delta Manor: development and new projects

items.t: Council has approved the detailed design for the Chisholm Street Wharf and construction is underway, with completion anticipated by late spring 2026 per the City release dated February 24, 2026.
For 2026 the flat-rate utility total is $1,658 for a single-family home, billed annually at the end of February, with metered water and sewer billed quarterly where metered.
Route 601 is the Canada Line link, running from South Delta via Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station.
Route 609 runs Ladner Exchange to South Delta Exchange via Arthur Drive and Ladner Trunk Road.

blocks.text: Delta Manor: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check streamside setbacks before planning an addition or coach house, because the 30-metre permit area can limit building work.
Confirm flood construction requirements for the specific lot with the City.
For any strata purchase, review bylaws, rules, fees and special levies before removing subjects, per provincial strata buying guidance.

Delta Manor against the rest of Ladner

Of the 7 Ladner neighbourhoods that recorded detached houses sales, Delta Manor was 3rd for volume with 18 sales and 5th of 6 for median price at $1,338,000. Of the 5 Ladner neighbourhoods that recorded condos sales, Delta Manor was 1st for volume with 22 sales and 4th of 4 for median price at $535,000. Of the 5 Ladner neighbourhoods that recorded townhomes sales, Delta Manor was 3rd for volume with 8 sales and 3rd of 5 for median price at $860,000.

faq.a: Catchments are address-based, so check the exact address first. West-Ladner addresses can fall to a different elementary school.
faq.q: Which schools serve a Delta Manor address?

faq.a: No, Delta Manor is a board name, not a City neighbourhood name. It covers the central Ladner grid around Delta Secondary and Memorial Park. The governing document is the consolidated Delta OCP 2024. The old Ladner schedule no longer exists as a separate schedule.
faq.q: Is Delta Manor an official neighbourhood?

faq.a: A suite or coach house may be allowed, depending on the parcel's zone. The RS1 material lists a secondary suite as an accessory use. Check the zoning map for the lot before counting on added rent.
faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house?

faq.a: Transit connects through Ladner Exchange on route 601 to Bridgeport Station. Route 601 runs from South Delta to the Canada Line. Route 618 loops Ladner North from Ladner Exchange via Ladner Trunk Road, Central Avenue, Westminster Avenue and Crescent Drive.
faq.q: How does transit connect to Richmond?

faq.a: No. It is the Paragon sub-area name for the central Ladner grid around Delta Secondary School and Memorial Park; the governing plan is the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, Bylaw No. 8400 — a single consolidated plan with no separate Ladner area plan.
faq.q: Is Delta Manor an official City of Delta neighbourhood?

faq.a: Yes — the RS1 zone in Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600 lists a secondary suite as an accessory use to a single detached dwelling, and the City's SSMUH amendments also cover secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies.
faq.q: Are secondary suites allowed in the single detached zones here?

faq.a: TransLink route 601 runs from South Delta to Bridgeport Station on the Canada Line, stopping at Ladner Exchange, and route 618 loops Ladner North from Ladner Exchange via Ladner Trunk Road, Central Avenue, Westminster Avenue and Crescent Drive.
